purpose: Test whether Literary OS can consume only human-written past episodes, select position-appropriate material for the next episode, design typed upper layers, and realize a >=35,000-character screenplay before the actual human target episode is revealed.
research_questions: Does explicit Series Position / Episode Function typing improve next-episode material selection versus the current candidate?
Can the candidate preserve human-world continuity without using target/future episode information?
After target reveal, how close are Candidate and Human choices at upper-layer architecture while remaining independently high-quality at surface level?

strata.primary_capability: world/character expansion, relationship baseline, opposition seed, incident timing
thread activation, focus allocation, subplot orchestration, escalation
long-horizon state consumption, convergence, payoff/debt management

arms.C: Current candidate planning without the new position-aware typed layer.
arms.T: Position-aware Treatment consuming SERIES_POSITION, EPISODE_FUNCTION, MATERIAL_PORTFOLIO, CHARACTER_FOCUS, THREAD_OPERATION, RELATIONSHIP_OPERATION, INFORMATION_OPERATION, OPPOSITION_EXPOSURE, INCIDENT_TIMING, EXPOSURE_BUDGET.
arms.H: Actual human target episode; physically and semantically hidden until both C and T plans and full surfaces are sealed.

target_custody_rule: No H target source, target-derived analysis, future-derived thread endpoint, payoff location, or post-cutoff summary may enter C/T inputs before seal.
stage_order: H1 three-position pilot: one EARLY, one MIDDLE, one LATE
H2 confirmatory multi-work benchmark only if H1 infrastructure and generation are valid

external_evaluation.upper_layer: blind C vs T causal comparison, plus post-reveal T vs H benchmark comparison
external_evaluation.prohibited_question: Do not use 'which one is human?' as the primary quality question.

abort_conditions: target episode accessed before candidate seal
claim_boundary: H0 qualifies benchmark infrastructure only. It does not itself qualify next-episode prediction, human-level quality, Production, Operational Level-3, or R140.
